infra.primary.sqlite.description: SQLite-dialect Primary Database providers — a future non-SQLite dialect (e.g. Postgres) would be a sibling layer under infra/primary, not a member here

sqlite.description: D1 runtime database, D1 deployment resource, and memory database are independent doors built on separate private schema and migration modules.

worker.description: Public — createAuthWorker(config) assembles Better Auth over a consumer-provided Primary Database, with Cookie Cache, Google OAuth, Admin, optional Dash and User Admission Policy, and origin and cookie settings. Consumers choose D1 or the memory database without coupling the worker to a provider.

client.description: Public — Direct Session Check: React hooks for session state, sign-in, and sign-out

server.description: Public — Server-Side Verification: forwards a Consumer Backend's request to the Auth Worker and returns a Verify Payload, plus each Sibling's Auth Cannotation: its Declaration (safe for contract code shared with the browser) and its Server Implementation

Server-Side Verification is the vanilla door; the Current Auth Resolver wraps it for Effect; each Sibling module declares its Auth Cannotation in an interior authz file (reached by the package's contract subpath) beside its Server Implementation, both over a shared Current Auth identity.

auth-toolkit.description: Independently consumed doors — worker, client, server, and the infra providers each stand alone; the consumer wires providers into the worker itself, so no Layer here imports another.
